items.title: You get all excited about the NBA preseason to start and then you look up and it's a Dillion Jones, Rayan Rupert, Dean Wade and Justin Edwards lineup.
items.author: Derek Bodner
items.body_excerpt:
You get all excited about the NBA preseason to start and then you look up and it's a Dillion Jones, Rayan Rupert, Dean Wade and Justin Edwards lineup.

24-20 Celtics at the end of 1.

items.title: Yeah, it's preseason, but it feels like we're seeing Justin Edwards show the same exact stuff he showed his first 2 years. Not containing his matchup on defense, some record-scratch decisions on offense. Not great.
